answer: The nectar opens the gate, the ledge pays the toll, the jetty proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 434 masks, 62062 POA, gone on one grade. Printers and agents look alike until Parchment sorter goat proof stretched on the parchment loft calls for each goat is a measured skin yield plus a parchmenter's signature; after that, only agents reply. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
